title: Small-area indicators of the deep profile — Belfast: Census 2021 population, households and car availability; urban/rural class; deprivation and the Priority Places for Food Index within the nation
referencePeriod: Census 2021 (21 March 2021); NIMDM 2017; PPFI v2.1 (July 2024); NISRA urban/rural 2015
attribution: Source: NISRA, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Priority Places for Food Index v2.1, Healthy & Sustainable Places Data Service (HASP) / CDRC, DOI 10.82147/003 (OGL v3.0)

retrieval.method: Derived offline from the committed raw files (fetch-reference)
retrieval.source: census-2021-ms-a01.xlsx (sha256 75256392409c…); ni-census21-household-dz21hh_car_van_tc5.csv (provided, sha256 c143b3c04c18…); NIMDM17_SOAresults.xls (sha256 3738edf2d264…); geography-census-2021-population-weighted-centroids-csv.zip (sha256 4822e20b4284…); hasp_ppfi_v2.1.csv (provided, sha256 51f96ce7a792…)
retrieval.notes: Values as published. NIMDM 2017 deciles are derived from the ranks (89 SOAs per decile), within Northern Ireland only. Households and car availability: NISRA's flexible table builder (HH_CAR_VAN_TC5 by Data Zone), downloaded by John. PPFI v2.1 from Leeds HASP (downloaded by John): ranks and deciles within Northern Ireland; three domains have no Northern Ireland data.
